'''''X-Wing: Mercy Kill''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel and the tenth and final volume in the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] series. It was written by [[Aaron Allston]] and first published by [[Del Rey]] in hardcover on [[August 7]], [[2012]]. The first paperback edition was released on [[June 25]], [[2013]].
